init.title: Autodarts options
init.description: **Online matches (experimental):** the integration sees the darts on your board, but not the game of an online match on play.autodarts.io. The browser extension Tools for Autodarts can send its moments, such as a bust, a game shot or a 180, to Home Assistant. They arrive as board events whose type starts with `online_`.

data.online_bridge: Receive online matches from Tools for Autodarts
data.online_bridge_remote: Accept calls from outside your home network

data_description.online_bridge: Opens a secret webhook address for the browser extension. The next step shows it.
data_description.online_bridge_remote: Only for an https address through Home Assistant Cloud or your own domain. Off: only devices in your home network can call the address.
data_description.online_bridge_new_address: The current address stops working. Enter the new one in Tools for Autodarts.

online_bridge.title: Address for Tools for Autodarts
online_bridge.description:
After you submit, Home Assistant accepts moments of online matches at this secret address:

`{url}`

In Tools for Autodarts, turn on **WLED**, choose **Import CSV** and paste the lines below. Each line creates an effect of type URL that calls the address with `?event=` and its trigger. Import only the lines you need: Tools for Autodarts plays one effect per trigger and picks one at random when several share a trigger.

```
{effects}
```

The *Online bridge last event* sensor shows the last moment that arrived. Keep the address to yourself: whoever knows it can send moments of a game to your Home Assistant.

board_manager_1.title: Update the board to the new Autodarts Board Manager
board_manager_1.description: This board runs the classic Board Manager app. Autodarts replaces it with the headless Board Manager 2 and will turn the old one off once most players have migrated. Install Board Manager 2 on the board PC; the integration switches over automatically and keeps working locally.

confirm.title: Calibrate now
confirm.description:
The board corrected {rate} % of the last darts. A fresh calibration usually brings this down.

Remove all darts from the board first. The calibration takes a few seconds.

abort.calibration_failed: The board did not accept the calibration. Try again, or calibrate from the board status card.
abort.board_unavailable: The board is not loaded. Check the connection and try again.

board_access_denied.title: Autodarts board refuses access
board_access_denied.description: The board at {address} answers with HTTP 401 or 403. Board Manager itself needs no login, so something between Home Assistant and the board blocks the requests, for example a reverse proxy, a firewall or a login in front of port 3180. Let Home Assistant reach the board; the notice disappears by itself.

unsupported_response.title: Autodarts board answers in an unknown format
unsupported_response.description: The board answers {reads} in a format this version of the integration does not understand, for example after a Board Manager update. Values from these reads are not updated. Update the Autodarts integration; if the notice stays, report it together with the diagnostics.

board_moved.title: Autodarts board found at a new address

confirm.title: Use the new address
confirm.description:
The board no longer answers at its old address. The Autodarts cloud reports it at {new}, where it answers with its board ID.

Connect the board there? The integration reloads; entities, training and settings are kept.

abort.board_unavailable: The board no longer answers at the new address. Wait for the next notice, or open the integration and choose **Reconfigure**.
